sizes.rule: Past maxFiles files, sizes roll up to the top two directory levels, except that a directory holding more than maxFiles files of its own shows them as files; past maxGroups groups, the smallest join "(other)".

languages.rule: Past maxSlices languages, the smallest join "Other".

history.rule: History is the tags plus the largestCommits biggest commits by lines changed; past maxTags tags, only the newest maxTags are kept.

edits.rule: Edits count commits in the months up to the newest commit; past maxFiles files, only the most edited maxFiles are kept.

imports.rule: Past maxNodes files, the graph rolls up to directories, at least two levels deep: the depth that shows the most directories within maxNodes. If none fits, the shallowest depth that has links is used (files, when every import stays inside one directory) and its least connected nodes join "(other)". Only the maxExternal most used outside packages are listed.

coChange.rule: Commits touching more than bulkCommitFiles files are skipped; past maxPairs pairs, only the most frequent maxPairs are kept.
